tools.name: search_stops
tools.title: Search Cyprus bus stops
tools.description: Search Aloya's Cyprus-wide bus stop directory (Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos, Intercity) by name or stop code. Returns matching stops with coordinates and agency.

query.description: Stop name or code fragment, e.g. 'Eleftheria' or '1234'.

tools.name: get_stop_arrivals
tools.title: Get live arrivals for a stop
tools.description: Fetch upcoming live bus arrivals for a specific Cyprus stop from Aloya's real-time feed. Returns route, trip, ETA (unix seconds) and delay.

stopId.description: The stop id (as returned by search_stops).

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.title: Plan a Cyprus bus trip from natural language
tools.description: Parse a natural-language trip request (e.g. 'Nicosia to Larnaca airport tomorrow 8am') into structured origin, destination and time using Aloya's planner. Returns parsed intent suitable for building a deep link to the app.

query.description: Free-form trip request in English or Greek.
